name: medicrm
description: MediCRM — React frontend and Prisma/Express backend

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,green "npm -w client run dev" "npm -w server run dev"
scripts.build: npm -w client run build && npm -w server run build
scripts.typecheck: npm -w client run typecheck && npm -w server run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm -w server test
